pages.text: The $(item)IV Inference Maintenance Hatch$() is an optional part mounted on the Clean Stainless Steel base of the $(item)Data Scrubbing Tower$() (at most 1 per tower).$(br2)Insert an edge chip and draw CWU/t from a compute rack on the same raised floor or via a GT optical cable.$(br2)Note: optical pipes do not auto-connect to pre-placed hatches — verify connections with a wrench.

pages.title: CWU/t Billing & Watchdog
pages.text: Applies to the tower's two raw-log scrubbing recipes (2048 EU/t base):$(li)$(#0E7490)Ordinary Edge Chip$() (mining or chemical): consumes $(bold)2 CWU/t$() every tick for $(bold)-25% EU/t$() (→ 1536 EU/t).$(li)$(#0E7490)Aligned Edge Chip$(): consumes $(bold)8 CWU/t$() every tick for $(bold)-50% EU/t$() (→ 1024 EU/t).$(br)Without a chip or CWU/t, it runs normally at 2048 EU/t. If CWU/t dies mid-batch, a watchdog interrupts the stalled run so the next cycle falls back to standard rules instead of soft-locking.

pages.title: Green Snack Pack Easter Egg
pages.text: Keep a $(item)Green Snack Pack$() in the $(item)Air-Cooled Compute Rack$()'s snack slot to trim total rack EU/t (IT, cooling, and standby) by $(#0E7490)5%$().$(br2)Enabled by default; server admins can disable it with `-Dhypercluster.snackBonus=false`.

pages.title: Industrial Inference
pages.text: Replace a GT multiblock maintenance hatch with this part. Insert a matching mining or chemical chip, or connect to a MoE router running a local model. Draw shared CWU/t from the same raised floor or use an optical cable between rooms.$(br2)Ordinary chips trade 2 CWU/t for 25% lower EU/t. Aligned chips trade 8 CWU/t for 50%. Demand doubles for each host voltage tier above IV.

pages.title: By-products and Maintenance
pages.text: A matching LoRA card or DeepSeek-V6767 Pro with DeepThink improves chanced by-product rolls. Guaranteed outputs keep their original quantities.$(br2)Aligned chips and online GLM deployments clear maintenance faults automatically. Right-click the hatch with duct tape to repair it manually.
